title: ProjectionIREntry
description: Normalized, read-only, ephemeral projection IR entry per graph/schema/projection-ir.md §3. Entries carry zero execution authority (CIRS-IR-01) and are never persisted (CIRS-IR-07).

source_operator.description: Which operator emitted this projection. Must match a registered operator (IR-04).

domain.description: Projection domain within the operator. Must be within the operator's declared domains (IR-04).

proposition.description: The projected content (operator-specific). Must not contain executable code (IR-01, IR-05).

confidence.description: Epistemic confidence: 0.0 (speculative) to 1.0 (certain). Set by the operator, not adjustable by consumers (IR-03).

constraints.description: CIRS-IR rules that apply to this entry (IR-META-01).

trace.description: Observation lineage — IDs of source observations or events (CAUSAL-01).

ProjectionIRStream.description: An ordered, append-only, ephemeral collection of entries from one cycle (projection-ir.md §3).
